title: Alice shields 25,000 mUSDC
summary: Alice deposits into the shielded pool. The deposit mints the compliance note her epoch chain starts from, and the amount is above the single-transaction threshold, so the pool emits a public size flag.
simplifications: One operator account deploys the contracts, attests the cohort, curates the blocklist, funds the deposits and relays every pool call. The spec gives these roles to separate parties.
The pool holds only this run's notes, so its anonymity set is far smaller than a busy pool's.
The audit committee is a single key (t = n = 1).
The wallet simulates each pool call and does not broadcast one that the pool refuses.
The chain is a local Anvil node.
